messages.text:
Two picks, both pre-sale.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at about 650 W, quiet desktop tower. Ships November 14, 2026. Best value per terahash we sell.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W, ~50 dB. Ships October 30, 2026. Lower power draw, so it's the easier one to live with if electricity is pricey or it sits in a bedroom or office.

Tell me where it'll run (state or country) and I'll run the sats and power cost for your rate.

Hey. Still here.

Where will the miner run, state or country? I'll work out the sats and the power cost at your rate and tell you which of the two makes sense.

Bahrain works, we ship rest of world, and both units take 100 to 240 V so the local supply is fine.

Straight answer: the Magic Miner 40T at $799 is the better buy, 40 TH/s for $16 a TH, our cheapest hashrate. Ships November 14, 2026. Take the B30 at $899 instead only if low draw matters more, 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W, ships October 30, 2026.

Prices exclude VAT and any duty Bahrain customs raises on delivery. Want me to set up the checkout?
Give me coins not popular with potential please

I can't call which coin will take off, that's not advice I'd give and nobody honestly can.

On hardware, what we sell mines either SHA-256 (Bitcoin) or scrypt (Litecoin and Dogecoin, merged). The scrypt side is the Nexus L1, 320 MH/s at $399.99, and the Hammer DC06 at 330 MH/s.

Heads up, the DC06 is oversold with no confirmed date right now, and the L1 ships when Nexus stock lands. Which algorithm are you after?

I won't pick a coin for you, that's your call and anyone promising you the next big one is guessing.

What I can say: our best gear mines Bitcoin, and that's what most of our customers run. Solo on a Magic Miner 40T or a Harlo B30, you're stacking sats and holding a small shot at a full block.

If you'd rather mine Litecoin and Dogecoin, that's the Nexus L1. Which way are you leaning?
